rye by brinkmann

sourdough starter · german organic rye · shipped worldwide

flour. water. time.

an active sourdough starter made with german organic rye, for baking bread at home. a starter is a living culture: you feed it flour and water, it raises your dough, and a small part is always kept for the next bake.

feeding instructions and a first-loaf guide give you a starting point for building your own baking routine.

what you get

  • an active rye starter
  • feeding instructions
  • a first-loaf guide
